en: Black‑and‑white image of a forested outdoor café in front of an elegant pavilion-style building with a steep tiled roof, dormers and a small clock on the façade. The structure has many tall windows and stands on a raised stone base. In the foreground among tall pine trees are metal café tables and folding chairs covered with patterned cloths. A well‑dressed man and woman in late‑19th/early‑20th‑century attire sit on chairs, with a child standing nearby. The scene suggests a resort or spa restaurant in a wooded, hilly landscape.
